command.name: security key-manager policy show
command.description: This command displays the defined key management key policies.

parameter.name: policy
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command will list the key manager policy with the given name.

parameter.name: check-key-on-online
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the key manager policies with the given check-key-on-online value.

parameter.name: purge-key-on-offline
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the key manager policies with the given purge-key-on-offline value.

parameter.name: support-on-admin-vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the key manager policies with the given support-on-admin-vserver value.

parameter.name: key-manager-attribute-required
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the key manager policies with the given key-manager-attribute-required value.

example.p: The following example lists all configured key management policies:
example.screen:
cluster-1::*> security key-manager policy show
Policy Check Key on Online? Purge Key on Offline? ----------------- -------------------- --------------------- IBM_Key_Lore true true
